name: Verifier for contact creation
description: Verifies that the new contact record for Joseph Johnson has been successfully created and linked to the Wonka Industries account.

validation_config.query: SELECT portal_user_id FROM contact WHERE contact_id = 125 AND account_id = 9 AND active = 1 AND is_primary = false;

name: Verifier for new case creation
description: Verifies that the critical case for the flash storage array has been created with the correct priority and product association.

validation_config.query: SELECT case_id FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 9 AND contact_id = 125 AND contact_id = 125 AND installed_product_id = 48 AND channel = 'web' AND priority = 'critical' AND state = 'new';
